Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public.

"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live"

IS  :  9942  -  1981 

Indian  Standard 

SPECIFICATION  FOR 
T-SIGN  PLATE  FOR  TRAILERS 

0.     FOREWORD 

0.1  This  Indian  Standard  was  adopted  by  the  Indian  Standards  Institution 
on  31  August  1981,  after  the  draft  finalized  by  the  Transport  Tractors 
and  Trailers  Sectional  Committee  had  been  approved  by  the  Marine, 
Cargo  Movement  and  Packaging  Division  Council. 

0.2  Under  the  motor  vehicle  rules,  any  motor  vehicle  to  which  a 
trailer  is,  or  trailers  are,  attached  on  the  rear*  of  the  trailer,  or  of  the 
last  trailer  in  the  train,  as  the  case  may  be,  a  T-sign  plate  must  be 
exhibited.  Since  this  is  an  important  cautionary  sign  for  the  traffic 
following  the  trailers  on  the  road,  the  preparation  of  the 
standard  has  been  undertaken  at  the  instance  of  all  those  connected 
with  safety  on  the  road. 

0.3  In  addition  to  the  basic  features  of  the  sign  plate,  this  standard  goes 
a  step  further  to  specify  other  features  so  as  to  make  the  sign  more 
effective  and  distinguishable. 

0.4  In  the  preparation  of  this  standard,  assistance  has  been  derived  from 
the  various  state  motor  vehicle  rules  in  the  country.  However,  if  any 
provision  of  this  standard  is  in  conflict  with  that  oi  the  motor  vehicle 
rules,  the  provision  in  the  motor  vehicle  rules  shall  prevail. 


1.  SCOPE 

1.1  This  standard  covers   T-sign   plates   for  trailers   attached  to  motor 
vehicles. 

2.  DIMENSIONS 

2.1  The  T-sign  plate  shall  be  at  least  175  mm  wide  and  200  mm  high. 

2.2  The  dimensions  of  the  'TJ  mark  shall  be  as  shown  in  Fig.  1.     These 
are  the  minimum  dimensions. 

3.  COLOURS 

3.1  The  plate  shall  be  painted  in  black. 

3.2  The  letter  CT'  shall  be  painted  in  white. 

2

4.  OTHER  REQUIREMENTS 

4.1  The  T-sign  shall  be  painted  with  a  luminous  paint  so  as  to  make  it 
visible  at  night.
